title: Fleet Management
description: ASP.NET Core MVC app to manage drivers, vehicles, and maintenance records. Role-based access (Admin/User), SQL Server with EF Core migrations, stored procedures, delete-audit triggers, and PDF exports with optional email delivery.

title: Weather CLI
description: A minimalist command-line weather tool written in Go. Fetches data from OpenWeather API and displays it with ASCII art.

title: Note App
description: Full-stack note-taking application with real-time sync, markdown support, and offline capabilities using service workers.

title: Pixel Art Editor
description: Browser-based pixel art editor with layers, animation timeline, and export to PNG/GIF. Built with Canvas API.
